verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is a datacenter AI accelerator, but media engines are a fair question for accelerator hardware, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only AI training, inference, networking and memory. It never mentions AV1/HEVC encoders, media engines, creator-app acceleration, or ISV-certified professional drivers, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
